# FG-WEB-0007

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 400 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `info_refs_needs_exactly_one_known_service` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: Git のサービスの指定が正しくありません。git-upload-pack か git-receive-pack を 1 つだけ指定してください。
- en: The Git service is not supported. Request exactly one of git-upload-pack or git-receive-pack.
- id: Layanan Git tidak didukung. Minta tepat satu dari git-upload-pack atau git-receive-pack.

## 原因 (cause)

A Smart HTTP advertisement request (`GET {path}.git/info/refs`) did not carry exactly one `service` query parameter whose value is `git-upload-pack` or `git-receive-pack` (byte for byte, no decoding, no case folding; ADR-0015 step 3). Decided from the string alone, before authentication and before any lookup, so it says nothing about the path. Dumb HTTP clients (no `service`) get this too: forge serves Smart HTTP only.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason=service_unsupported`, `part=query` and `rule`: `missing` (no `service` key: a dumb-HTTP client or a scanner), `duplicate` (two `service` keys), `unknown` (another value, e.g. `git-upload-archive`, an encoded or upper-case one). `path=` is the raw path cut by `log_safe_path`.

## 対処 (fix)

Use a git client (git >= 2.0 speaks Smart HTTP); the remote URL is `https://<host>/<namespace>/<project>.git`. Nothing to fix on the server.
